title: Aeronautics Bare
description: Turns Create:Aeronautics into the bare bones minecraft trailer look!
body:
Turns the **Create:Aeronautics** mod into the bare bones minecraft trailer look!
After months of aeronautics being out i decided to play a modpack with bare bones and wanted aeronautics to feel barebones so i made this texture pack. 
![Portable engines](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75cfc8703248f10d71e40718ca9c38b529deac88.png)






**Currently**
Every single texture has been remade
However as this is my first texture pack in years it might have some inconsistencies and look a little bad but feel free to leave a comment on how i could improve it!
